lines.en: “Yoo Joonghyuk, you crazy bastard!”

I charged toward Yoo Joonghyuk, practically screaming. I was so startled that I couldn't even control the power of my skills. [Electrification] and [Way of the Wind] activated simultaneously through [Bookmark], and my body shot forward like lightning, colliding squarely with his.
Booooom!

The magic power of [White Pure Star Energy] colored the air, and the star on the display stand flew up and rolled across the floor. Having withstood my magic power, Yoo Joonghyuk spoke without looking at me.
“Move.”
“What do you mean, move? Have you actually lost your mind?”
I couldn't believe him.
Another character, perhaps—but Yoo Joonghyuk, who knew perfectly well what this meant, reaching for the ‘star’? It was unthinkable.
“Don't you know what Scenario 46 is? Did you even read the scenario properly?”
Of course, there was no way Yoo Joonghyuk hadn't read the scenario properly.
“I did.”
“If you pick that up, it's over for everyone!”
“Not necessarily. Most people acquire that star and move on to the next scenario.”
Yoo Joonghyuk slowly turned toward me.
An expression without the slightest trace of agitation.
This wasn't his first time in Scenario 46.
「People can participate in Scenario 46 only with members of their own nebula or people they recognize as ‘companions’.」

In an earlier round, Yoo Joonghyuk had entered Scenario 46 with everything calculated. Unwilling to accept restrictions, he hadn't joined a great nebula. Instead, he had gathered the companions he'd recruited and challenged the scenario. He had also made full use of the information through the 41st round that he'd received from the future Shin Yoosung.
But there was one person even Yoo Joonghyuk hadn't anticipated. Someone who had adapted to the new future Yoo Joonghyuk had brought about and appeared as his companion.
「“I trust you, Yoo Joonghyuk.”」
The Prophet, ‘Anna Croft’.
In the previous round, she had been one of Yoo Joonghyuk's companions.
I held out a hand to block him and said,
“Yoo Joonghyuk.”
I'd thought he would be better now.
I'd thought living a life entirely different from his previous rounds would have changed him.
We'd made it this far, saving each other's lives time and again. I'd thought that something called trust would have formed.
“I'm not Anna Croft. I won't betray you.”
「“I trusted you not to betray me.”」
Yoo Joonghyuk had failed Scenario 46 because of Anna Croft.

He'd lost his companions and everything he owned. Yoo Joonghyuk had survived, but it wasn't survival. Stripped of everything by Anna Croft, his very existence subjugated, he'd lived like a slave after Scenario 46 until he died.
Yoo Joonghyuk looked at me and said,
“Kim Dokja, you said you were a prophet.”
A chill settled over Yoo Joonghyuk's expression.
“I don't like you. I never have.”
Ruuuuumble!
A transcendent's waves of energy erupted from Yoo Joonghyuk's entire body.
As he drew [Black Heavenly Demon Sword] and struck without the slightest hesitation, I pushed the power of [Electrification] to its limit.
Krrrrrrk!
A shock wave jolting my hand, my body flung away like an insect.
Now I was truly angry, too.
“You goddamn bastard―!”
Booooooom!
[Releasing the Status of a ‘Demon King’!]
After [Electrification], even [Demon King Transformation].
I concentrated every bit of strength I had to counter Yoo Joonghyuk's power.
The second round we'd left unfinished before had begun.
Glancing at the ‘star’ rolling far away, swept up in the collision of our Status, I shouted,
“We're almost there, and you're giving up here? You want my skills and Stories that badly?”
Yoo Joonghyuk didn't answer.
I bit my lip and swung my sword in a frenzy. [Unbreakable Faith] and [Black Heavenly Demon Sword] collided with a screech that threatened to split my eardrums.
······Yes, it wasn't as though I couldn't understand.
Yoo Joonghyuk had been betrayed by a prophet in the previous round, so the power he wanted most would be prophecy itself.
And he still mistakenly believed I was a ‘prophet’.
「Kim Dok ja is stu pid」
What?
[The exclusive skill, ‘Fourth Wall’, activates!]
[‘Fourth Wall’ shakes with laughter.]
Suddenly, my mind cleared, as though someone had dumped cold water over me.
Was Yoo Joonghyuk really trying to kill me because I was a ‘prophet’?
Was he doing this to get his hands on my skills and Stories?
······Had everything he'd done been an act, all for this one moment?
[Unread messages remain in ‘Midday Tryst’.]
An item that held traces of the past 3 years.
I activated ‘Midday Tryst’ as I blocked Yoo Joonghyuk's sword strikes.
[You have ??? messages that arrived in your absence.]
[The messages are damaged and cannot be read.]
Damn it······.
「Want some he lp?」
With those words, messages began arranging themselves inside my head.
[The damaged messages are partially restored through the authority of ‘Fourth Wall’.]
The messages Yoo Joonghyuk must have left began playing back, incomplete, through the mouth of [Fourth Wall].
「Lee Gil young Shin Yoo sung annoy ing brats」
「Lee Hyun sung fool ish sol dier」
······What ridiculous notes. Had he been using the chat window as a notepad?
「Jung Hee won Han Soo young don't get a long」
「Lee Ji hye not ver y bright」
「Yoo Sang ah need less ly cle ver」
Anyone reading these would think he'd written nothing but insults about our companions.
But I knew Yoo Joonghyuk well enough to understand.
Yoo Joonghyuk never said so much as a word about anyone he didn't care about.
「Kim Dok ja.」
For a moment, dizziness struck me as though I'd been hit in the head with a hammer.
“Yoo Joonghyuk, are you······.”
To begin with, this scenario only activated for people recognized as ‘companions’.
If he hadn't trusted me, if he hadn't recognized me as a companion, we couldn't even have entered this scenario.
[Your understanding of the character ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ rises explosively!]
[The exclusive skill, ‘Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint’, activates!]
I stared blankly at Yoo Joonghyuk.
Yoo Joonghyuk didn't want my skills or Stories.
At last, he spoke.
“I've tolerated your recklessness long enough.”
His [Black Heavenly Demon Sword] was aimed squarely at my throat.
“We lost 3 years because you did as you pleased. It won't happen again.”
“It was necessary. There was no other way to reach a proper ■■!”
“No one knows whether the ■■ you're pursuing is a proper one.”
“······So now you're going to take ‘absolute authority over my life and death’?”
Quiet fury burned in Yoo Joonghyuk's eyes.
“At least this way, you won't try to sacrifice yourself on your own again. And the others······ won't do anything pointless, either.”
[Fourth Wall] was still reading the sentences in [Midday Tryst].
「Lee Ji hye tak ing her own life light ly」
「Lee Hyun sung de lib erately leapt a mong the mon sters」
Only then did I realize what ‘pointless things’ our companions had done.
I spoke as though making a declaration.
“I'll never do anything like that again.”
“Who wants to die? I didn't want to do that back there, either.”
Yoo Joonghyuk didn't lower the sword aimed at me.
Eyes that didn't believe a word I said.
In the end, I had no choice but to try a different approach.
“Yoo Joonghyuk, if you use that ‘star’, you might gain ‘absolute authority over my life and death’, but you'll also acquire a ‘Traitor Story’.”
A Traitor Story.
“Once you acquire that Story, you won't be able to earn your companions' trust, even if you move on to the next scenario. No one will trust you anymore. Is that how you want to live?”
No one wants to be hated.
That was true even of the cold-blooded regressor Yoo Joonghyuk.
All the more so now that he'd finally gained true ‘companions’.
“It doesn't matter.”
“What?”
Yoo Joonghyuk looked at me.
Through ‘Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint’, I could hear his thoughts.
「······If only I were you.」
It was something the Yoo Joonghyuk I knew would never think.
The instant my feet froze, Yoo Joonghyuk moved toward the ‘star’.
Suddenly, everything around me slowed, as though someone had seized both ends of time and pulled them apart.
―By the way, is the Yoo Joonghyuk in your worldline still doing okay?
Within that slowed time, I heard the voice of the 1863rd round's Han Sooyoung.

―The Yoo Joonghyuk here is hardened through and through, but in his 3rd round, his mind would still be pretty soft, wouldn't it? If someone like you showed up and started throwing his weight around, it'd definitely crush his confidence.
As he approached the ‘star’, Yoo Joonghyuk no longer wore the expression of a protagonist.
The arrogant, confident Yoo Joonghyuk I remembered was gone.
Instead, Yoo Joonghyuk looked frightened of something.
「This world needs Kim Dokja.」
「And so do the others······.」
「I'm not the one who can clear the scenarios to the very end.」
[Fourth Wall] spoke.
「You wan ted this too」
My ears rang, and everything I'd done so far flashed through my mind.
My history unfolded like a panorama: taking what Yoo Joonghyuk should have gained, stealing the places he should have occupied.
「“I am Yoo Joonghyuk.”」
The words I'd tossed out like a joke were coming back to me, every one of them.
The histories I'd taken without much thought had made Yoo Joonghyuk what he was now.
「You wan ted to be the pro tagonist」
No.
[Fourth Wall] spoke.
「You are Yoo Joonghyuk.」
I'm not Yoo Joonghyuk.
「Kim Dokja is Yoo Joonghyuk.」
I don't want to be the protagonist.
「Then what are you com plet ing the sce na rios for?」
What was I completing the scenarios for?
I can see Yoo Joonghyuk reaching for the ‘star’. I murmured inwardly.
······If I could explain that in words, why would I have been clearing the scenarios?
[‘Fourth Wall’ exhibits an unknown reaction.]

Cr-r-rack. The sound came from inside my head, like a small crack forming in something very solid. Hearing it, I charged toward Yoo Joonghyuk. He turned as though he'd been waiting and released his Status at me.
The power of a transcendent who had reached full maturity.
Over the past 3 years, Yoo Joonghyuk had grown stronger.
[The character ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ tells the Giant Story ‘Demon Realm's Spring’.]
“You're no match for me.”
“Maybe not.”
Yoo Joonghyuk had grown so strong that I couldn't defeat him, even after visiting the 1863rd round.
So strong that I couldn't understand how his confidence could have fallen so low.
“But I know someone who can beat you.”
Yoo Joonghyuk was afraid.
Because the information he'd received from the 41st round's Shin Yoosung would be running out.
Because soon, stories he didn't know would begin.
[Unlocking the ‘Story’ received as a reward for the ‘Otherworld Pledge’.]
So I had to show him.
You are more than this.
The 41st round is far from the limit of how far you can reach.
[You have acquired a ‘Myth-grade Story’!]
[This Story was passed down to you by someone.]
With a dazzling burst of light, messages exploded inside my head.
[‘A Single Story’ reacts to your Myth-grade Story!]
[This Myth-grade Story is sufficient to replace a Giant Story!]
[Your first Myth-grade Story has completed part of ‘Development (承)’!]
[Part of the Story was lost during transmission, leaving ‘Development’ incomplete.]
[Acquire another Myth-grade Story or Giant Story.]
······I hadn't originally planned to acquire this Story.
Nor had I expected a Story from the 1863rd round to find its way into the story I would create.
But now that things had turned out this way, using it wouldn't be a bad idea.
[The scale of this Story far exceeds your narrative capacity.]
[At your reading comprehension level, you can interpret only part of this Story.]
Blood ran from my nose, and my whole body shook as though I'd been electrocuted.
Pitch-black shadows were gathering around Yoo Joonghyuk and me. The scene in the room shifted, and the smell of sulfur came from somewhere. Burning hellfire and the scent of blood covered the floor.
I heard Yoo Joonghyuk shout something in alarm.
Without responding, I looked at the countless shadows waiting for me.
[Assessing the rounds you can interpret at your reading comprehension level.]
Numbers flashed rapidly across my retinas.
[The highest round of ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ you can comprehend is the ‘41st round’.]
[Would you like to select the ‘41st round’?]
As I slowly nodded, Yoo Joonghyuk's emotions filled my mind.
Terrible despair and helplessness.
Emotions worn away by grueling scenarios.
Depression that threatened to drive me mad took shape and attacked me, while mocking laughter rang out again and again.
I endured it all.
[You are imbued with the talent of ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ from that round.]
Amid that fathomless loneliness, a shadow watched me.
The 41st round's Yoo Joonghyuk.
The heartless man who had sent Shin Yoosung to his past self.
He spoke to me.
「My specialty is the ‘spear’.」
A spear made of pitch-black shadow appeared before me.
Without hesitation, I took it in my hand.
[The Story, ‘Hell of Eternity’, begins its story.]
The Story, ‘Hell of Eternity’.
It was the Story the 1863rd round's Yoo Joonghyuk had passed on to me.
Tzzzzzz······!
[Many constellations are astonished by your ‘Story’.]
[The nebula <Asgard> takes notice of your Story.]
[The nebula <Vedas> takes notice of your Story.]
A Story drawing the attention of entire nebulae.
It wasn't surprising. This was a ‘Myth-grade Story’, after all, and it possessed enough destructive power to replace even part of a ‘Giant Story’.
Yoo Joonghyuk's eyes were wavering, too.
‘Hell of Eternity’—a Story that let me borrow, however briefly, the ‘history’ Yoo Joonghyuk had accumulated through 1863 regressions.
From the spear in my grip, I felt a power that wasn't mine.
This ‘Story’ couldn't let me borrow Yoo Joonghyuk's skills or stigmas.
But Yoo Joonghyuk's true strength wasn't something constructed through the system. It was something he had made part of himself through a transcendent's training.
「To take that spear in his hand, Yoo Joonghyuk practiced a single form for decades.」
The 41st round's Yoo Joonghyuk.
Instead of seeking the Breaking the Sky Sword Saint, he had sought the legacy of the vanished <Zeroth Murim>.
The martial art of a world destroyed long ago.
Soul Killing Spear (滅魂神槍).
A demonic martial art (魔功) of supreme power, comparable to [Breaking the Sky Swordsmanship], said to be the strongest in Murim.
With this single spear, the 41st round's Yoo Joonghyuk had exterminated the returnees.
The 3rd round's Yoo Joonghyuk would probably recognize this power, too. It was one of the martial arts he'd had in mind.
“That's right. It's the power you were planning to learn.”

I spoke with a hardened expression. The hand gripping the spear shook as if palsied. An excessive concentration of Status. Only the 41st round. By that 41st round, Yoo Joonghyuk had already reached this level.
Rrrrrumble!
Beyond skills or stigmas, a power the human Yoo Joonghyuk had devoted his life to accumulating.
This was the ‘Status of a transcendent’.
The waves of dizziness made me feel I might collapse at any moment, but I held on and kept holding on. The mental strain was greater than the physical. But if this burden was purely mental.
[The exclusive skill ‘Fourth Wall’ is active!]
Somehow, I could endure it.
“Come at me, Yoo Joonghyuk.”

The Yoo Joonghyuk within the Story takes his stance. I could have fought more effectively with a Star Relic like [Ongho Halberd] or [White Lightning Divine Spear], but this ‘shadow spear’ was enough for now.
It was enough, said the virtual 41st-round personality I had summoned.
「Weak. In perfect shape to regress.」
Yoo Joonghyuk had grown weak.
Perhaps I was the one who had made him weak.
“Come at me properly, or I'll kill you.”
At those words, a torrent of transcendence surged from Yoo Joonghyuk's entire body, too.
He had realized I meant it.
Neither of us moved first. We charged at each other together.
Booooom!
Status collided with Status in midair with a deafening roar. Through the thick clouds of rising dust, the spear shadows (槍影) of [Soul Killing Spear] split into dozens, then hundreds.
Clang-clang-clang-clang!
[Breaking the Sky Swordsmanship] began to give ground under the assault of [Soul Killing Spear].
A power that was neither skill nor stigma.
A history forged through 41 regressions, given form through effort.
Boom-boom-boom-boom!
Bursts of spear light (槍光) from [Soul Killing Spear] left wounds across Yoo Joonghyuk's body.
“Is this all you've got? After 3 years, this is all you can do?”

I was gasping for breath, and dizziness returned as my magic power ran dry. Still, I kept talking. To provoke him, I spat out increasingly inflammatory words. Yoo Joonghyuk's thoughts drifted through the air.
「What if I'd claimed the ‘Absolute Throne’ back then?」
Amid overflowing regret, Yoo Joonghyuk retreated and retreated.
「If only I'd tried harder.」
Falling back, and falling back again.
At the end of that endless retreat, Yoo Joonghyuk found himself up against a wall, as he always did.
A wall that left him nowhere to retreat.
I thrust my spear at him.
The charging spearhead spoke to Yoo Joonghyuk.
「No, you did try.」
Yoo Joonghyuk's pupils widened as he evaded the spearhead by a hair. He trembled at the sight of the spear embedded in the wall. Its tip kept speaking.
「It simply wasn't enough.」
Yoo Joonghyuk's trembling slowly subsided. His wavering eyes steadied, and a cold image coiled deep within them.
[The Story, ‘Hell of Eternity’, influences the incarnation ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’.]

Yoo Joonghyuk raised his sword again. As the tip of [Soul Killing Spear] cut through the air, the sword energy of [Breaking the Sky Swordsmanship] met it along the same path. Blue sparks flew, and Yoo Joonghyuk looked at the ‘spear’, not me. With every clash, the space and time around us changed.
The time of transcendence was opening.
「You were the one who sent Shin Yoosung to me.」
「That's right.」
Yoo Joonghyuk kept swinging his sword. His strikes were less refined than before.
The trajectories were unsteady, the forms clumsy.
His [Breaking the Sky Swordsmanship], which had clearly been on the verge of completion, was coming apart again.
Yoo Joonghyuk asked,
「Can I become this strong after going through 41 rounds?」
「To be precise, only this strong.」
To transcend transcendence, one must find the courage to discard one's existing framework.
Only relentless obsession and a yearning for perfection, like those of an architect tearing down a castle over a single window frame, can unlock a new path of transcendence.
And Yoo Joonghyuk chose his path.
Cr-r-r-rack.

Whenever [Breaking the Sky Swordsmanship] clashed with [Soul Killing Spear], its form (形) crumbled. Its trajectory (軌) changes, its intent (意) shifts. In the end, a transcendent's power follows the grain of the Story he pursues.
Yoo Joonghyuk's history was one of growing stronger with every enormous obstacle he faced. That history was preparing to leap forward once more.
「Grow stronger, Yoo Joonghyuk.」
Yoo Joonghyuk and Yoo Joonghyuk were talking.
[The Demon King, ‘Demon King of Salvation’, looks at the incarnation ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’.]
And perhaps this was my role.
Yoo Joonghyuk, reaching a certain point in his life and looking within himself.
Watching that Yoo Joonghyuk, I think about myself.
Unable to become the protagonist.
Unable to save anyone.
But at least I know the story, and I can pass it on.
Every spear strike held sentences I had read.
That terrible 3rd round.
That 41st round of bitter regret.
That hellish 1863rd round.
I had read it all, without missing a single sentence.
Aaaaaaaaah!
Within those clashes, Yoo Joonghyuk was living other lives.
Just as I had lived life through ‘Ways of Survival’, Yoo Joonghyuk, too, was living a life he had never lived, amid the screech of clashing weapons.
The 3rd round's Yoo Joonghyuk was growing through the 41st round.
[The character ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ gazes at the Story ‘Hell of Eternity’.]
A person cannot be saved by someone else.
Only they can save themselves.
For another person, the most I could do was serve as a bridge (橋梁).
“You're just another failure.”
Yoo Joonghyuk spoke.
“I don't take advice from failures.”
At last, he was the Yoo Joonghyuk I knew.

The trajectories of the evolved [Breaking the Sky Swordsmanship] follow the flow of [Soul Killing Spear]. The relentlessly pursuing sword strikes break through the spear's shadows and sever its continuous rhythm.
Yoo Joonghyuk may falter, but he doesn't give up. He doesn't stop even in despair, and even when everything crumbles, he picks up the first block again.
「I am Yoo Joonghyuk.」
“No.”
And at last, he surpasses himself.
“I am Yoo Joonghyuk.”
Exploding energy scattered in every direction, destroying parts of the room.
[The Story, ‘Hell of Eternity’, finishes its telling.]

The blazing hellscape vanished, and the scent of blood faded. Amid the pale dust, the sharp blade of [Black Heavenly Demon Sword] rested against my Adam's apple. Almost simultaneously, the [Unbreakable Faith] I had extended also rested against the spot over his heart.
[The constellation, ‘Maritime War God’, is sincerely impressed.]
[The constellation, ‘One Who Overcomes the Late Trials’, pays their respects.]
[The constellation, ‘The Last Hero of Hwangsanbeol’, marvels at a duel between true martial artists.]
As though time had stopped, nothing filled the space around us but labored breathing. Within that intermittently broken silence, Yoo Joonghyuk glared at me.
The 3rd round's Yoo Joonghyuk, who had surpassed the 41st round, spoke.
“I won.”
I smiled.
“What are you talking about? I won.”
The star rolling across the floor shone brightly.
[The scenario's time limit has expired.]
Like a small blessing, the star burst in midair and scattered into silver light.
We gazed blankly up at that light.
[No one in this room acquired the star.]
[No one harmed a companion.]
The 46th scenario, ‘Proof of the Stars’.
This scenario could be cleared ‘properly’ when all participants refrained from harming one another.
[You have proven your ‘trust’.]
But no one who had made it through the scenarios to number 46 would think to clear it that way.
Beyond this point, the world of constellations.
No incarnation would abandon one last chance to increase their strength.
When one star is born, another sets. And no one shares the light.
[You have acquired a new Story!]
[You have fulfilled the scenario's clear conditions.]
When I came to my senses, we were both lying flat on the floor, as though we'd agreed to it.
Neither Yoo Joonghyuk nor I had the strength to hold out any longer. My consciousness shorted out for an instant, then returned. As I blinked my eyes open, I heard Yoo Joonghyuk mutter.
“······A shame.”
“It is. That was my chance to get the Supreme King's Stories.”

Even as I refused to let him have the last word, I kept chuckling. Every muscle in my body hurt as though it might tear apart. I'd chewed and swallowed several [Great Return Pills] that I'd secretly stashed away, but my battered incarnation body was recovering more slowly than I'd expected. That was how severe a strain ‘Hell of Eternity’ imposed.
“You look perfectly fine, don't you?”
Even while gasping for breath, Yoo Joonghyuk seemed to be thinking constantly about something.
The insight he'd just gained had probably brought him to a new level. I guess that's talent. I'm jealous.
······Well, he is the protagonist.
The silent protagonist spoke.
“You said you visited another worldline.”
I'd been wondering why he hadn't asked.
“Which round was it?”
“The 1863rd round.”
Was that number simply too distant to grasp?
Yoo Joonghyuk was silent for a while.
“Did the me from that worldline give you the Story you just used?”
“That's right.”
Yoo Joonghyuk didn't ask for any further details.
Instead, after thinking for a moment, he asked,
“Did I······ fail there, too?”
I gazed quietly up into the air before answering.
“He succeeded.”
I felt Yoo Joonghyuk stiffen.
[‘Fourth Wall’ trembles faintly.]
The 1863rd round's Yoo Joonghyuk, who had gone beyond the rounds of the original novel and set out to find his own story. Remembering my last glimpse of him, I continued.
“He'll be able to reach the end of the scenarios. Perhaps an ending even I don't know.”
“······It seems you didn't actually confirm it, either.”
“If I had, I wouldn't have been able to come back.”
“Seeing the end there wouldn't have been a bad choice.”
“That isn't my world.”
I spoke as I looked up into empty space.
“My world is here.”
Yoo Joonghyuk said nothing for a long time.
I rubbed at my lips, which resisted turning upward, and smiled.
“Here, I have Yoosung, my incarnation, and my coworker Yoo Sangah-ssi, and Han Sooyoung, who hasn't completely gone over to the dark side yet, and my mother······.”
“Don't celebrate yet. It isn't over.”
That was when a dokkaebi's voice came from the air.
[Oh, one of the rooms has finished already. Hehe, as expected······ a thrilling battle worthy of the scenarios' rising stars!]

It wasn't Youngki. Quite a few dokkaebis were in charge of this scenario, so perhaps the one overseeing us had changed. I struggled to get up. Yoo Joonghyuk was right. This scenario wasn't over yet. He spoke.
“The participants in the other rooms were sent in after us.”
Indeed, the following message floated before our eyes.
[Waiting for the nebula's members to clear the scenario.]
Then Youngki's voice rang out.
[As a special privilege, those who have fulfilled the clear conditions will be shown the other rooms!]
Several screens appearing before us with the message.
Countless indirect messages immediately stabbed at my ears.
[The Demon King, ‘Ruler of Eastern Hell’, watches the clash between the two constellations.]
[The Demon King, ‘Black Mane Lion’, shows deep interest in the battle.]
[The constellation, ‘Guardian of Youths and Travel’, takes notice of the battlefield.]
[The constellation, ‘Friend of Justice and Harmony’, wears a worried expression.]
[The constellation, ‘Twisted Head of Disaster’, wishes for a dear friend's victory.]
Formidable modifiers rarely seen together in one place. I fixed my gaze on one of the screens. I'd wondered why all these big names were here······.
······Damn it. So it had come to this after all.
Black and red waves of magic power collided on the screen.
A spectacle of magic power filling the entire room.
Hellfire that seemed capable of melting anything clashed with black flames of terrifying destructive power. Just watching made me feel as though my flesh would cook in the heat.
The two most fearsome constellations I knew.
Their incarnations were clashing.
‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon’.
And ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’.
I heard the dokkaebi laugh.
[Well, it looks like the room with the wrong pairing will end rather anticlimactically.]
Everything in the room caught fire amid the explosion of dark red waves of magic power. Pale silhouettes wavered through the whitish haze.
The sharp sound of flesh tearing.
Someone's figure was slowly crumpling within the smoke.
Watching fragments of the ceiling patter down, Jung Heewon gazed silently into the dust. Through the pale haze, she could see Han Sooyoung lying on the ground.
‘Judge of Evil’ versus ‘Black Flames Demon Ruler’.
‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’ versus ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon’.

Every constellation on the Korean Peninsula had eagerly awaited this battle, but neither of the people fighting looked remotely pleased. Stepping through the dust, Jung Heewon aimed [Sword of Judgement] at the fallen Han Sooyoung and spoke.
“How about you drop the act.”
Han Sooyoung's figure crumbled into powder and scattered. A sharp whistle cut through the air. Jung Heewon reflexively twisted and thrust her sword behind her.
The screech of clashing metal. Han Sooyoung's unbandaged right hand, holding pitch-black darkness, had caught [Sword of Judgement].
“······Didn't fool you, huh?”
“I know you have the Avatar skill.”
Brilliant white light burst from [Sword of Judgement].
“You're the ‘First Apostle’, after all.”
Booooom!
Their Status collided, and the two women moved apart at the same instant.
Red ghostly flames flickered in Jung Heewon's eyes as she activated [Demon Slaying].
While [Demon Slaying] increases its user's attack power, it also intensifies unstable emotions. It heightens sorrow and amplifies anger.
“You were the one who attacked our companions at Chungmuro, too.”
The battle at Chungmuro, when [Struggle for the Flag] was in full swing.
That had been Han Sooyoung's first encounter with the group.
“Jihye and Gilyoung almost died back then.”
“······You weren't the one who almost died, so why are you getting angry? You weren't even there, were you?”
“I'm angry because I wasn't there. If I had been, I wouldn't have let you get away with it.”

A light flashed in midair, and the events of [Struggle for the Flag] were projected as holographic footage. Probably a service from the dokkaebis for constellations who hadn't been in the channel back then. Lee Jihye and Lee Gilyoung, horribly wounded in the apostles' attack. Han Sooyoung spoke as though she'd had enough.
